steps.label: Key multiplier
steps.headline: One key (or none yet), so everything below is measured at full height.

steps.label: Wealth tier
steps.headline: Your portfolio is worth $1,077,000, which lands in tier 4.
steps.formula: tier = count of thresholds [100, 1k, 10k, 100k] that portfolio x keyMultiplier clears
steps.effect: Top tier — the tallest towers and the richest materials are unlocked.

steps.label: Activity level
steps.headline: 60,000 lifetime transactions, log-scaled, gives activity 4.00.

inputs.label: Lifetime transactions
inputs.note: exact count from the explorer, not an estimate

steps.effect: The single biggest driver of how many buildings you get: it contributes 16.0 of them. Log-scaled on purpose — transactions are nearly free on an L2, so spamming them barely moves the city.

steps.label: Diversity score
steps.headline: 8 tokens, 20 NFTs and 0 distinct transaction types give diversity 3.91.

inputs.label: Distinct tx types
inputs.note: weighted 1.5 each — the hardest of the three to fake

steps.formula: min(4, log2((tokens x 0.5 + nfts x 0.5 + txTypes x 1.5) x keyMultiplier + 1))
steps.effect: Adds 4.7 buildings and widens the mix of what gets built.

steps.label: Building count
steps.headline: 3 to start, plus 16.0 earned by activity and 4.7 by diversity.
steps.formula: max(3, round(3 + activityExact x 4 + diversityExact x 1.2))
steps.effect: Built from the EXACT activity and diversity values, not the rounded tiers — that is why your city changes when you trade, instead of only when you cross a tier boundary an order of magnitude away. Range is 3 to 24.

steps.label: Concentration
steps.headline: 31.6% of your portfolio is in INDEX, so it gets the dominant tower.
steps.effect: A spread portfolio earns an even skyline rather than one landmark.

steps.label: Age
steps.headline: This city was founded on November 9, 2021 — the day this wallet made its first transaction. It has existed ever since.

inputs.label: First transaction
inputs.note: the day the city was founded

steps.effect: Your key did not build this city. It has been here since your first transaction, drawing itself from everything the wallet did afterwards — the key only unlocks the ability to look at it.

steps.label: Sky, weather and architecture
steps.headline: These are the only parts of your city that are not on-chain.

inputs.label: Local sky
inputs.note: real local time where your city sits

steps.formula: sky and weather = live conditions at the city’s assigned location
steps.effect: Sets the palette, the light and the architectural style. It moves with the real world, so your city is a different picture at 3am than at noon.

steps.label: Placement
steps.headline: Your wallet decides WHAT gets built. The seed decides WHERE each piece lands.
steps.formula: deterministic RNG seeded on the wallet address
steps.working: same wallet -> same layout, every time
steps.effect: No transaction maps to a specific pixel, and this report will never claim one does. Counts, heights, materials and mix are all earned above; the arrangement is seeded, so your city is stable rather than reshuffling on every view.

steps.label: Building mix
steps.headline: Four independent signals decide what kind of city you get, not just how big.
steps.formula: each weight / sum of all four weights
steps.effect: Deliberately NOT key-boosted. Keys build the city you already have, faster — they must not quietly turn it into somebody else’s city. All four are log-scaled so one big number cannot flatten the other three.
